terminal-full.description: Full-width — all 12 columns. Data header, output blocks.

terminal-main.description: 80-column reading zone — ~720px for monospace body text. Primary content.

terminal-split.description: Binary split — two equal panels with 1px phosphor hairline divider

terminal-wide.description: 3fr 2fr asymmetric — main content + sidebar metadata panel

terminal-cards.description: 3-column card grid for features. Equal-width bordered panels.

panel.description: Terminal window panel — 1px solid border, 24px padding, 0 border-radius

panel-titled.description: Terminal window with header title bar — 40px title bar, 1px separator, content padding 24px

_twist.twistDescription: 80-column terminal constraint — 720px content column for monospace body text. Full-width container 1200px with 40px padding. Panel system: 1px phosphor hairline border (rgba 57,255,20,0.2), 0 border-radius, 24px padding. terminal-split uses 1fr 1px 1fr for visible phosphor divider. terminal-cards: 3-col with 8px gap for feature panels. All layout vocabulary terminal-prefixed. Gutters 8px — pixel grid precision.
